key.name: ha-token
key.description: Created in HA user profile (Long-Lived Access Tokens).

key.name: ha-panel-entities
key.summary: Entities displayed in the top bar
key.description: List of entity_ids (typically sensors) whose values are shown in the panel.

key.name: value-decimals
key.summary: Number of decimal places for numeric values
key.description: -1 = automatic (per entity suggested_display_precision attribute), 0-4 = fixed number of decimal places.

key.name: entity-icon
key.description: ha = icon from Home Assistant (mdi:... from entity attributes; bundled MDI icons), type = icon based on entity domain, text = no icons.

key.name: entity-configs
key.description: Map of entity_id to JSON override object: {"decimals":0-4, "icon":"ha"|"type"|"text", "display":"auto"|"icon"|"icon-value"|"value", "name":"custom name", "min":number, "max":number}. Missing keys inherit global settings.

key.name: hotkey-open-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to open menu and focus Assist chat
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that opens the extension menu and focuses the Assist conversation entry.

key.name: ha-menu-entities
key.description: List of entity_ids; the control widget is selected automatically by domain.

key.name: ma-token
key.description: Created in MA settings (Users/API keys). Empty if MA does not require authentication.

key.name: ma-default-player
key.description: Player player_id. Empty = automatic (first active/playing player).

key.name: ma-mpris
key.description: Selected players will be controllable via media keys and native GNOME media controls.

key.name: mpris-players
key.description: Selected players ("ma:<player_id>" or "ha:<entity_id>"). Empty = active MA player.

key.name: ma-show-dj-selector
key.description: Submenu to select an AI Radio DJ host or turn off DJ in Music Assistant.

key.name: interface-language
key.description: auto = system language; or forced language (en, cs, nl). Applies to both the menu and the preferences window (after reopening).

key.name: panel-show-status
key.summary: Show connection status dots in panel

key.name: allow-insecure-tls
key.description: For servers with self-signed certificates (requires libsoup 3.2+).
